en: Isaiah 5

p.src: 1  Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

en: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.
u.src: 1  Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

p.src: 2  He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

ja: て、 そこにぶどう搾り場も
en: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
u.src: 2  He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

p.src: 3  “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

ja: 々よ、 どうか、わたしとわたしのぶどう
en: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.
u.src: 3  “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

p.src: 4  What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

ja: をすることができただろうか。
ち望んだのに、 なぜ
en: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?
u.src: 4  What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

p.src: 5  Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

ja: をするか、 あなたがたに知らせよう。 その生け
らされるままにする。 その
み荒らされるままにする。
en: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.
u.src: 5  Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

p.src: 6  I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

ja: を耕すこともなく、 いばらと茨が
en: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”
u.src: 6  I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

p.src: 7  For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

ja: 々は主が喜びとした植え木である。
よ、そこには虐げがあった。 義を待ち望んだが、 見よ、苦しみの叫びがあった。
en: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.
u.src: 7  For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

p.src: 8  Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

ja: をなくし、 国の中に
en: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!
u.src: 8  Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

p.src: 9  In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

en: In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.
u.src: 9  In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

p.src: 10  For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

en: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”
u.src: 10  For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

ja:
5:10 直訳では「十くびき」。これは十組の牛が一日に耕せる土地の広さで、約10エーカー、または4ヘクタールである。
5:10 一バトは約22リットル、または約5.8ガロンである。
5:10 一ホメルは約220リットル、または6ブッシェルである。
5:10 一エパは約22リットル、または約0.6ブッシェルである。これは約2ペックで、まかれた量のわずか10分の1である。
en:
5:10 literally, ten yokes, or the amount of land that ten yokes of oxen can plow in one day, which is about 10 acres or 4 hectares.
5:10 1 bath is about 22 liters or 5.8 U. S. gallons
5:10 1 homer is about 220 liters or 6 bushels
5:10 1 ephah is about 22 liters or 0.6 bushels or about 2 pecks—only one tenth of what was sown.

p.src: 11  Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

ja: くまで居残って、ぶどう
en: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!
u.src: 11  Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

p.src: 12  The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

ja: の業を考えようともしない。
en: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.
u.src: 12  The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

p.src: 13  Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

en: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.
u.src: 13  Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

p.src: 14  Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

en: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.
u.src: 14  Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

ja: 5:14 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 5:14 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 15  So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

ja: くされ、 人々はへりくだらされ、
en: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
u.src: 15  So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

p.src: 16  but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

en: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.
u.src: 16  but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

p.src: 17  Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

ja: べ、 よそ者は裕福な
en: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.
u.src: 17  Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

p.src: 18  Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

en: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,
u.src: 18  Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

p.src: 19  who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

ja: を行わせよ。 われわれがそれを
られるように。 イスラエルの
させよ。 われわれがそれを
ることができるように。」
en: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”
u.src: 19  who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

p.src: 20  Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

ja: たちに災いがある。 彼らは
en: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
u.src: 20  Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

p.src: 21  Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

en: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
u.src: 21  Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

p.src: 22  Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

en: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;
u.src: 22  Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

p.src: 23  who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

ja: を無罪とし、 罪のない
en: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!
u.src: 23  who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

p.src: 24  Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of the LORD of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

ja: の中で崩れ落ちるように、
の律法を退け、 イスラエルの
